verdict.rationale: Runtime probes show a public OpenAPI 3.1 spec (~405 paths) with Swagger UI served at /docs, which gives an interactive, explorable reference. However, it is the internal app/bridge API, and the probe notes no developer program or public API keys documented around it, so runnable try-it calls are not clearly usable by outside users. Missing for 10: curated runnable examples, documented API access/keys for external developers, first-party developer docs framing the reference, independent hands-on corroboration.
